_about: 3-12 (step 172, R1). Right off the spawn block to the floor; a shot at anti_portal_agent_ent_1377
(196, 164) kills it (tick ~88) and antiportal_1376 (99 px) goes with it. A portal at (100, 200) and
one beside crate_small_ent_1372 at (125, 113): the crate goes through, and rolling_stone_1198, which
it held in its nook inside antiportal_1375's field, rolls down to the floor by the left wall. A
portal over the crate at (120, 150) and one on the player, who lands on the crate. A portal against
the left face of breakable_wall_ent_1368 at (320, 140) and one over the stone at (30, 188): the
stone comes out touching the wall and breaks it (tick 380). A portal at (410, 140), outside
antiportal_1533's 42 px, and one on the player: down onto the key's shelf, left to take the key, off
the shelf's end onto the keyhole's platform, where the key opens the yellow door; right into the
door. The knights never see or shoot (G1, not built). Won on tick 636 (step 172).
